about: Circle VIII, the Rune Bridges (Docs/Story.md: ink-violet void, cyan runes with a soft halo, pale grey masonry, mist bands at three depths, distant bridges as silhouettes): the stills Tools/Art/climb_art.py bakes (climb.json pieces runeSpan, runePillar, runeLanding, runeVoid, runeIsland, runeArches). fx_make --no-bake makes them into SickOfItGameEnemies/Generated/fx/runebridges/.
name: RuneBridges

span.png.prompt: Paint one long flat slab of pale grey carved stone seen from the side, the deck of a narrow floating bridge segment: a flat walkable top, a thick edge face carved with a long groove of rune glyphs (dark, unlit), chipped worn corners, a few hanging stone teeth underneath. One object alone, wide and flat across the picture. Plain flat pure magenta background (#ff00ff), no floor, no shadow, no scenery, centered with empty space around it. Dark fantasy video game art for a side-scrolling game: painterly, detailed, cold pale cyan rune light, ink-violet shadows.
